cards.title: ICE arrival at München Hbf
cards.summary: Train from Stuttgart Hbf (demo booking). Allow 15 min to get out of the station.
cards.duration_basis: assumption: 15 min from platform to station exit

metadata.note: Plausible ICE arrival; the October 2027 timetable is not bookable yet.

cards.title: Drop luggage at Hotel Uhland
cards.summary: Leave bags before check-in. Reception is staffed 07:00–23:00; luggage storage before check-in is not documented.
cards.duration_basis: assumption: 10 min at reception

cards.title: Glockenspiel at Marienplatz
cards.summary: The figures of the New City Hall carillon perform daily at 11:00 and 12:00, plus 17:00 from March to October. Free, watched from the square.
cards.duration_basis: estimate: show lasts about 12–15 min (travel guides; not stated on muenchen.de)

cards.title: Frauenkirche & south tower view
cards.summary: Munich's cathedral; the south tower platform gives a view over the old town. Tower: Mon–Sat 10:00–17:00, Sun and holidays 11:30–17:00, last ascent 16:30.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 45 min (stairs + lift, platform, church)

cards.title: Lunch at Weisses Bräuhaus
cards.summary: Classic Bavarian tavern of the Schneider Weisse brewery in the Tal. Open daily 09:00–23:30, hot food until 22:30.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 75 min for a sit-down lunch

cards.title: Viktualienmarkt stroll
cards.summary: Munich's food market. City minimum selling times: Mon–Fri 10:00–18:00, Sat 10:00–15:00; stalls closed on Sundays and public holidays.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 40 min stroll

cards.title: Residenz München
cards.summary: Former royal palace of the Wittelsbachs: Antiquarium, state rooms, Treasury. Summer hours daily 09:00–18:00, last entry 17:00.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 2 h for the Residence Museum

cards.title: Check in at Hotel Uhland
cards.summary: From the uploaded booking: check-in from 15:00. Breakfast included.
cards.duration_basis: assumption: 15 min at reception

cards.title: Dinner at Augustiner-Keller
cards.summary: Traditional Augustiner beer hall and chestnut beer garden between Hbf and Hackerbrücke, ten minutes from the hotel. Beer from wooden barrels.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 90 min dinner
cards.reservation_note: Recommended on a Wiesn Saturday; online booking on the official site

metadata.recommendation_basis: muenchen.de restaurant guide; near the hotel

cards.title: Breakfast at Hotel Uhland
cards.summary: Buffet breakfast, included in the room rate. Served daily 07:30–10:00.
cards.duration_basis: assumption: 45 min

cards.title: Check out of Hotel Uhland
cards.summary: From the uploaded booking: check-out until 11:00. The hotel website states both 11:00 and 12:00.
cards.duration_basis: assumption: 15 min

cards.title: Oktoberfest – last Wiesn day
cards.summary: Final day of Oktoberfest 2027. Grounds, tents and rides open at 09:00 (Oide Wiesn 10:00). Go early: tents fill up fast on the last Sunday.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 2 h 15 min walk-around and rides before the Böllerschießen
cards.price_text: Free entry; Oide Wiesn admission extra. Beer 2026: €14.80–15.90 per litre

cards.title: Böllerschießen at the Bavaria
cards.summary: Traditional farewell to the Wiesn: about 60 marksmen fire salute shots on the steps below the Bavaria at 12:00, followed by brass music and the Bavarian anthem.
cards.duration_basis: start 12:00 per oktoberfest.de/muenchen.de; end time not published, 30 min estimated

cards.title: Lunch in a Wiesn tent
cards.summary: Roast chicken and a Maß in one of the beer tents. Without a reservation, look for unreserved tables or try the smaller tents.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 75 min
cards.reservation_note: Tent reservations for the last weekend are usually gone; unreserved areas exist

cards.title: Alte Pinakothek
cards.summary: Old Masters from the 14th to 18th century (Dürer, Rubens, Raphael). Open on 3 Oct 2027 until 18:00 per muenchen.de; €1 entry on Sundays.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 2 h
cards.price_text: €1 on Sundays (regular price disputed: €9 official, €7 muenchen.de)

cards.title: ICE departure from München Hbf
cards.summary: Train back to Stuttgart (demo booking). Be on the platform 15 min early.
cards.duration_basis: assumption: 15 min to find the platform

cards.title: Deutsches Museum
cards.summary: One of the world's largest science and technology museums, on an island in the Isar. Daily 09:00–17:00, last admission 16:30.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 2.5 h (very large museum; pick a few halls)

cards.title: Cocktails at Schumann's
cards.summary: Legendary bar at the Hofgarten. Saturday opening hours disagree between sources.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 90 min

cards.title: Englischer Garten & Chinese Tower
cards.summary: Walk through the English Garden to the Chinese Tower beer garden (one of the largest in Munich). Park open all year; beer garden weather-dependent.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 90 min walk incl. a drink

cards.title: Pinakothek der Moderne
cards.summary: Art, design, architecture and graphic art of the 20th and 21st century under one roof. Tue–Sun 10:00–18:00, Thu until 20:00.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 2 h

cards.title: Climb the Alter Peter
cards.summary: Tower of Munich's oldest parish church right next to Marienplatz. April–October 09:00–19:30, last entry 19:00.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 40 min (stairs up and down, view)

cards.title: Hofbräuhaus am Platzl
cards.summary: The famous state brewery beer hall with brass band. Kitchen until 22:00. Weekend opening time differs between sources.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 90 min
cards.reservation_note: No reservations for the Schwemme; groups of 4+ should reserve upstairs

cards.title: Olympiaturm view
cards.summary: TV tower in the Olympic Park with a 190 m viewing platform. Closed for renovation; reopening planned for 2027, date not confirmed.
cards.duration_basis: visit style normal: 1 h (based on pre-renovation operation)
